coreDecision: No PAL-specific claim is promoted to Core in Wave 3. Existing Core/responsibility laws are sufficient; the new results mainly constrain research and reusable explanation.

knowledgeCandidates.claim: Persistence/availability is a precondition for future use, not evidence of adaptive value.
Recursive/change depth is descriptive vocabulary, not a reliable value or compounding predictor.
Retained priors are future decision-boundary interventions and may help or harm depending on model/task family; historical success does not grant permanent authority.
Externalization value depends on observed reconstruction burden after safe responsibility placement; determinism/future-model robustness alone are insufficient.
Explicit variation is not a default improvement mechanism when strong direct generation already covers the causal space; added candidates can shift the bottleneck into selection.
Current consumption and future option value are different dimensions; latent option value can be real even when a generic retention rule cannot identify it prospectively.
